name: explainer
description: Turn "how does X work?" into an interactive, step-by-step explainer page with an animated diagram, lessons and a message inspector that says what each message does and why.

interface.shortDescription: Interactive, step-by-step explainers of how things work.
interface.longDescription: Ask how a system, protocol, process or incident works and get one self-contained HTML page: the parts drawn as isometric icons, the messages between them played step by step, and every message open to inspect. A checker enforces plain writing, accurate labels and a consistent template; topics are saved so pages can be revised later.
defaultPrompt: Explain how OAuth sign-in works, as an explainer.
Turn this incident write-up into an explainer I can step through.
Make an explainer of how our deploy pipeline works from these files.
